decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><p>SLP Rev A – Location and Block Plans; E01 – Existing Plans; E02 – Existing Roof Plan; E03– Existing Elevations; P01 Rev A – Proposed Plans; P02 Rev A - Proposed Roof Plan; P03 Rev A -&nbsp; Proposed Elevations;); Design and Access Statement (Rev A - Dated Jan 2025); Fire Strategy Statement</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in any side elevation at first floor level, or on the side boundary with 131 Malvern Avenue, of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.</p>
description: Single storey front extension incorporating porch, Single and two storey side to rear extension, First floor rear extension with Juliette balcony, External alterations
